source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus a NUL separator, file bytes and a trailing NUL separator for each path, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

implementation.cli: Explicit --vault and --open arguments open an existing absolute vault through a validated IPC method; optional --open paths must remain safe vault-relative paths.
implementation.deep_link: Only openobsidian://open is parsed. The Electron single-instance and macOS open-url paths deliver the typed intent to the renderer, which opens the vault and optional note through the same broker.
implementation.protocol_boundary: obsidian:// inputs are ignored, unknown Electron switches are ignored, malformed owned inputs fail closed, and no obsidian protocol registration or hijack is introduced.
implementation.vault_boundary: The main process rejects missing, non-directory, symlink and non-absolute launch vault roots before constructing VaultStore; note opens remain read-only until an explicit editor save.

checks.result: Five valid CLI/deep-link cases and three invalid cases pass the executable matrix.
Three focused tests pass with nine expectations, including obsidian:// non-hijacking and traversal rejection.
TypeScript compilation succeeds for the main/preload/renderer launch-intent contract.
Electron main, preload and renderer bundles compile with the launch-intent IPC.
145 tests pass with 770 expectations; the entry-point validator is included in the routine gate.
No dead-code or changed-file Fallow issues; inherited renderer complexity remains report-only.

checks.procedure: Packaged Electron 44.3.0 Linux x64 launch with --vault=<synthetic temp vault> --open=Note.md and CDP DOM readback
checks.result: The renderer opened the synthetic vault and Note.md through the launch intent; the title, vault label, editor path and revision status were visible.

checks.procedure: Packaged Electron 44.3.0 Linux x64 launch with quoted openobsidian://open?vault=<encoded synthetic temp vault>&file=Deep.md and CDP DOM readback
checks.result: The renderer opened the synthetic vault and Deep.md through the owned deep-link scheme.

limitations: Runtime launch evidence is Linux x64 only and uses disposable synthetic vaults; macOS/Windows protocol registration, second-instance handoff and reference Obsidian behavior remain pending.
The entry-point parser does not claim Obsidian CLI command compatibility or paid Sync/Publish interoperability; those surfaces remain separate handoffs.
No popout window, plugin-created view, screen-reader, IME or human focus validation was performed.
The selected /home/ashutosh/Obsidian vault was not accessed or modified.
result: Explicit CLI and OpenObsidian deep-link opening is implemented and locally exercised while obsidian:// remains untouched; cross-platform, reference and broader external-tool certification remain open.
